author: plutarch
text: Plutarch, Parallel Lives — the ten in the room
note: The richest harvest so far: the Lives name philosophers (Aristotle, Plato, Pythagoras), poets (Homer, Euripides, Sophocles), historians (Thucydides, Polybius), kings and legends across Greek and Roman history. Brutus here is MARCUS (the assassin, the Life’s subject) — the third context for the name, and the roster’s Brutus point should be checked against which one it holds.

flagged_for_review.issue: likely Ptolemy son of Lagus (Alexander’s general), not the astronomer — the roster point may be the wrong Ptolemy
